title: Ingestion inventory unit
description: One (deployment, layer) ingestion unit. See docs/specs/INGESTION_INVENTORY_SPEC.md §3. Shape only — cross-unit invariants (prefix overlap, global raw_table uniqueness, vocabulary membership) are checked by `ol-dbt inventory validate`, which JSON Schema cannot express.

local.description: `mirror` is deliberately absent: a laptop has no Vault path and no route to a production replica (RFC 12711 §3).

mirror_max_age_days.description: Required iff a strategy is `mirror`; no default, so it is a decision per unit.

loader.description: What actually loads these tables. `dagster` is a bespoke asset pipeline under dg_projects/ — neither an Airbyte connection nor a dlt source, so it carries neither block. It exists because the inventory claims to record everything we load (§2), and edxorg's course archives are loaded that way.

table_prefix.description: Declared, never parsed from table names (§1.1). Conventionally ends in `__` to name a family, but a single-table unit whose one table is not a `__`-terminated family — a deployment's tracking logs, say — declares that table's full name instead. Requiring the trailing `__` made those units unexpressible: their only `__`-terminated prefix is the deployment's whole Open edX namespace, which swallows its mysql, api and mongodb units. The partition is guaranteed by the pairwise-overlap rule, not by this pattern.

dagster_visible.description: False asserts that no dbt model depends on this unit, which is the only way a connection may be named so that Dagster's selector drops it (§3.3 rule 6).

replication_method.description: How the source detects change; `xmin` has no dlt equivalent (§3.4).

connections.description: A list: one unit legitimately has several connections, e.g. a huge table split out to run on its own cadence (§3.5).

name.description: Byte-exact, arrow included — Dagster derives group names from it (§1.3).
The stream name at the source.

namespace.description: The stream's source namespace (schema/database), e.g. `public` or `edxapp`. Required whenever the live connection sets one — 790 of 1,518 streams do — because `configurations.streams[]` carries it and an import that omits it cannot produce a clean preview (§6.4). It is also what disambiguates equal table names in two schemas.

primary_key.description: One entry per key column; each entry is the column's path as a list of segments, matching `configurations.streams[].primaryKey` — never a dotted string, which cannot tell a literal dot in a segment from a path boundary.

modeled.description: True iff this table is declared in the dbt sources YAML (§1.4).

renamed_from.description: The full previous raw_table this table replaces, so the removal check does not fire (§7.2). Not the bare stream name.
